CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository provides the **Rotshield** plugin for unRAID.
Rotshield is a btrfs scrubber for unRAID/NonRAID arrays. It checks your data disks for bitrot the same way `btrfs scrub` does, and on the rare occasion it finds actual corruption, it rebuilds the bad blocks from the array's P/Q parity instead of just reporting them.
It runs as a native plugin with a Settings-page UI: pick the target data disk(s), run a scrub on demand or on a schedule, and watch live per-disk progress and results. Recovery is always verified against the filesystem checksums before anything is written back.
For support or questions, please open an issue on GitHub.
